page: Google Cloud Platform n4d-highmem-96 is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 48 physical AMD EPYC 9B45 cores, utilizing simultaneous multithreading with 2 threads per core. The system is equipped with 768 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and has zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results place the n4d-highmem-96 in the top tier for both single-core and multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng, as well as PassMark CPU and physics tests. Memory performance is robust, with cached small-block read-only bandwidth reaching the top 10% at 9232.0 GB/sec, while large-block uncached read and write bandwidths fall within the top 25% tier. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, and AVX-512 BF16, which contribute to its top-tier performance in cryptographic operations and data decompression.

The high memory density and strong computational capabilities make this instance suitable for memory-intensive workloads such as database operations, where it achieves top-tier PassMark database and Redis SET performance. It is also capable of handling medium-scale LLM inference, demonstrating top-tier text generation speeds for 7B models. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the combination of a high-density memory array and dedicated AMD EPYC cores provides a balanced resource allocation for enterprise databases, static web serving, and memory-bound data processing pipelines without the overhead of bundled local storage.
description: Google Cloud Platform n4d-highmem-96 is a memory-optimized server instance featuring 96 dedicated vCPUs and 768 GB of RAM, powered by an AMD EPYC 9B45 processor with x86_64 architecture. It contains 48 physical cores with 2 threads per core, offering 8 GB of memory per core. The instance lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. In benchmark evaluations, the n4d-highmem-96 delivers top-tier performance in multi-core CPU execution, database operations, and Redis SET throughput. It also achieves top-tier results in small-block memory bandwidth and single-threaded decompression. Supported instruction sets include AVX-512 and cryptographic accelerations like AES and SHA_NI. This configuration is designed for memory-intensive applications, enterprise database hosting, static web serving, and medium-scale language model inference.
